author: Susan Jenkins
text: I have an iPhone 12 Pro. The last few updates made me have to turn it off a couple of times then it worked. Check your Bluetooth connectivity too. I have had no problem updating my phone and having it work with the scanning program. I just turned it off and on at the beginning.

author: Linda Goins Fox
text: I used to have the IPhone 13 Pro Max. I never had any problems with it, but I never let my iPhone update by itself. I waited to see if someone else had done that. Did you try restarting your iPhone and turning your Bluetooth off and on. Sometimes it took two or three tries
